admin.subtitulo: Management of users, families, DVH/DVV integrity and backups
admin.errCarga: This data could not be loaded. Check your connection or permissions and try again.
admin.errVerificar: The audit log could not be verified. Check your connection or permissions and try again.

integridad.vacio1: Click <1>“Verify integrity”</1> to recalculate DVH + DVV for every audit log record.
integridad.vacio2: The system walks through every row of the audit log, recalculates the individual hash (DVH) and the chained hash (DVV), and compares them with the stored values. Any altered row is identified.
integridad.explicacion: Each row has a <1>DVH</1> (SHA-256 hash of its own fields) and a <1>DVV</1> (chained hash that includes the previous row’s DVV). If any field of a row is altered, the DVH changes and breaks the whole DVV chain from that row on.
integridad.inmutable: In addition, the audit log is immutable: a database trigger rejects UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE, even for the superuser.

ayuda.subtitulo: How to use AEGIS Urban according to your role

emergencias.texto: AEGIS Urban is a prototype and does not replace the official agencies. Call 911 (police), 100 (fire) or 103 (Civil Defense).

pasos: Open “View as a citizen” on the sign-in screen: no account is needed.
Check the current weather and the alerts. Each alert says whether it is REAL (weather) or SIMULATED (demo sensors).
If you want location alerts, tap “Allow location”. You can revoke it at any time.
If you are inside a danger zone you will see a red screen telling you which way to move away.
To have an account: “Create account”, accept the terms and verify your email and phone with the codes.
Sign in with your username and password.
On the Dashboard check the summary of sensors and alerts.
On the Map locate the sensors by zone.
On Alerts filter by severity, zone or date to find what you need.
Acknowledge the alert before starting an evacuation.
Start the evacuation: the system picks the strategy by severity and type, and centers the plan on the sensor.
In Simulation create exercises with simulated sensors and stop them whenever you want.
Resolve the alert when the emergency is over.
Go to Administration → Audit log to see the recorded actions.
Use “Verify integrity” to recalculate DVH and DVV.
Your access is read-only: you cannot change the status of alerts.
Users and Families: review who has access and with which role.
Backups: create a backup and run the restore drill regularly.
Restoring replaces the current data: it asks for written confirmation and first creates a safety backup.
Automatic backups run every 24 h and the last 7 are kept.

faq.p: What do REAL and SIMULATED mean?
faq.r: REAL is data from an external source (Open-Meteo weather). SIMULATED is generated by the virtual demo sensors. Simulations are not official alerts.

faq.p: How does the location alert work?
faq.r: With your permission, the browser sends your position only to calculate the distance to each risk zone. It is not stored.

faq.p: Why am I asked to verify my profile?
faq.r: To confirm that the email and the phone are yours: you receive a 6-digit code on each. In this version the SMS is simulated: the code appears on screen.

faq.p: I did not receive the code
faq.r: Check your spam folder and wait 30 seconds to request another. Each code expires after 10 minutes and allows 5 attempts.

faq.p: How do I change the language?
faq.r: With the ES / EN selector. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
They are fingerprints (hashes) of each audit log row: the DVH protects each row and the DVV chains them together. If someone tampers with the log, the system detects it.

faq.p: How do I make a backup?
faq.r: Administration → Backups → “Create backup now”. An automatic one is also made every 24 h.

faq.p: How do I download my data or delete my account?
faq.r: In the citizen view, “My data” section: “Download my data” and “Delete my account”.
